notes: Read from the official source listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.
Employers withhold a flat 3.07% of compensation. There is no standard deduction, exemption or allowance in Pennsylvania withholding.
Employee 401(k) deferrals are added back to federal wages for Pennsylvania (PIT guide appendix, Part A item 6), so they do not reduce state withholding. Section 125 health premiums are excluded.
Employee unemployment contribution: 0.07% of gross wages for 2026, with no wage cap (PA Department of Labor and Industry).
Most Pennsylvania localities levy an earned income tax; enter your rate in the local rate field.
